look_here_first: Look at texture before color: this is an herbaceous perennial with conspicuously silky few-foliolate leaves and a densely white-villous, fuzzy conic-to-cylindrical flower head.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: herbaceous perennial from woody taproot/root crown

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: odd-pinnate leaves usually with 3–7 larger silky/strigose leaflets

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: terminal headlike spike tightly packed and conspicuously fuzzy

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: bracts, rachis and calyx densely white-villous/sericeous

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Herbaceous perennial; not a woody shrub.

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Usually 3–7 obovate to oblanceolate conspicuously silky leaflets.

key_traits.label: Inflorescence
key_traits.text: Dense terminal headlike spike, conic to cylindrical.

key_traits.label: Calyx
key_traits.text: Bracts, rachis and calyx densely villous/sericeous.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: One-seeded indehiscent pod retained with the calyx.
